excluded: Mutable/proxied/custom receivers, replaced ECMAScript built-ins, storage acquisition, clocks not supplied as arguments, I/O, and catalog publication are outside this pure frozen-snapshot family.

laws.equation: Positions(selector) is the canonical-identity-ordered sequence of exactly those projection rows reached by the narrowest available item/revision/location index and satisfying the normalized selector; every dangling index reference throws.

StockSummary groups Positions(selector) by exact item revision, includes the requested/active zero row, adds exact measurement vectors for signed, physical, deficit, optional-identity, and qualified-dimension buckets, and orders every observable sequence by its immutable identity.

Availability at canonical time t is physical stock minus the once-per-location-pool recorded deficit and all active competing claims, clamped at zero per exact axis, together with the feasibility status of the same complete reservation graph.

Allocation validates time/item/selector/amount, excludes disallowed expiry and claims, pays each selected deficit pool once, searches the complete bounded increment state space before deterministic FIFO/FEFO fallback, and returns exact lines, shortfalls, deficits, and explanation flags without changing the snapshot.
Every observed authority time must be a non-empty canonical ISO instant; invalid or non-canonical spellings throw before read semantics can depend on them.

CollectionSummary resolves the exact retained definition, summarizes every exact member under one normalized scope, and emits only declared scalar rollups using exact reference conversion and stable member/contribution ordering.

Reservation feasibility groups active claims by exact competing axis, applies shared deficit burden, exhaustively assigns bounded indivisible groups, then computes maximum continuous bigint flow; feasible means and only means total fulfillable minor units equal total requested minor units.

higherOrderClosures.closure: All nine reachable invocations supply an inline arrow whose body is embedded in a certified stock-summary declaration term.
The snapshot policy root omits allocateInventory.acceptAllocations, so destructuring binds undefined and both guarded callback invocations are unreachable in this specialization.
The sole reachable invocation supplies the local recursive search arrow embedded in maximumReservationAssignmentWithIndivisibleGroups.
